description.name: Entry
description.text: Causes [Imperil Dark 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Earth 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Wind 10% (15s)], grants [Buff Dark 10% (15s)]/[Buff Earth 10% (15s)]/[Buff Wind 10% (15s)] to all allies, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Emperor], [Accursed Storm Ability Tracker] and [Accursed Storm Level]

description.name: Buff Dark 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Dark damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Earth 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Earth damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Wind 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Wind damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Emperor
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Accursed Storm (0~2), removed after using Accursed Storm two times

description.name: Accursed Storm Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Accursed Storm level by 1 after using 7 Dark, Earth or Wind abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Emperor]

description.name: Accursed Storm Level
description.text: Keeps track of Accursed Storm level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Emperor]
